name: Midnight Indexer 4.4.0-rc.6
body:
# Midnight Indexer 4.4.0-rc.6 Release Notes

> [!CAUTION]
> Upgrading from `4.4.0-rc.5`: **no reindex required**, **unless an earlier release has already indexed a ledger 8 to 9 hard fork**. That deployment keeps serving pre-fork contract state encodings until it is reindexed from genesis.
>
> Upgrading from `4.4.0-rc.3` or earlier: **reindex from genesis**, wiping the indexer database and the ledger DB together. Contract state moved into the ledger arena in `4.4.0-rc.4`, and the stored blobs cannot be converted.
>
> Upgrading from any `4.3` release: **not an upgrade path**. Moving between the two lines means a **reset and a reindex from genesis**.

## Metadata

- **Release type**: minor
  The major tracks GraphQL API v4, so breaking changes ship in minor releases.
- **Date**: 2026-11-02
- **Sister-line note**: This release is on the `4.4` line, which indexes ledger 8 and the ledger 8 to 9 hard fork. Operators on the ledger-8-only `4.3` line should track the `4.3` releases instead.
- **Environment**: Devnet and qanet
- **Released artifact(s)**: five container images; see **Artifacts** below.
- **Git tag**: [`v4.4.0-rc.6`](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-indexer/tree/v4.4.0-rc.6), signed, on [commit e141219d](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-indexer/commit/e141219d4f993378195f133425f41e3a501a8a9a)
- **Tree hash**: `220541521957e16e8c7df169b2cc5487f147ed3d`
- **Component class**: core/infra
- **Upgrade scope**: binary only (see **Deployment information** below)
- **Reset required**: No from `4.4.0-rc.5`, unless an earlier release has already indexed a ledger 8 to 9 hard fork; yes otherwise (see **Deployment information** below)
- **Governance action required**: Not applicable (see **Deployment information** below)

## High-level summary

This release candidate fixes a security issue where a single transaction could halt indexing, two other indexing halts, and several bugs affecting wallets. At a ledger 8 to 9 hard fork it now translates every contract's state to the new ledger version, which changes what the contract actions subscription replays (see Breaking changes). It also moves to node 2.1.0-rc.4 and restores Docker Hub publishing.

## Audience

- Operators running the indexer on the `4.4` line.
- Developers and wallet integrators using the indexer GraphQL API.

## Dependencies

- Supports node versions `0.22.0`, `1.0.300`, `2.0.0-rc.4` and `2.1.0-rc.4`. Node 1.0.300 replaces 1.0.0, 2.0.0-rc.4 replaces 2.0.0-rc.3, and 2.1.0-rc.4 replaces 2.1.0-beta.1.
- Ledger v8 `8.1.1` → `8.1.2` and ledger v9 `9.1.0.0-rc.4` → `9.1.0.0-rc.5` since `4.4.0-rc.5`.
- Migrations: 11 postgres, 12 sqlite and 1 sqlite ledger-DB. New since `4.4.0-rc.5`: postgres `010` and sqlite `012`, `contract_action_translations`.
- GraphQL schema: additive since `4.4.0-rc.5`. A new `BlockReference` type and a `stateAt` field on `Contract` and every `ContractAction`.

**Downstream impact (cascading effects)**: Clients that decode contract `state` must decode it by `stateAt.protocolVersion`, since it can be newer than `transaction.protocolVersion` after a hard fork. A `contractActions` subscription now starts at its offset; see Breaking changes.

## Tested-with versions

Build pins, not QA-verified.

| Component | Tested-with version |
| --- | --- |
| Midnight node | [`2.1.0-rc.4`](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/releases/tag/node-2.1.0-rc.4), the last line of `NODE_VERSIONS` at [commit e141219d](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-indexer/commit/e141219d4f993378195f133425f41e3a501a8a9a) |
| Midnight ledger v9 | `crate-ledger-9.1.0.0-rc.5`, pinned in `Cargo.lock` at [commit 6abe9b16](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-ledger/commit/6abe9b16f1a2a9965a3317729cd72fd1f7fbfc03) |
| Midnight ledger v8 | [`8.1.2`](https://crates.io/crates/midnight-ledger/8.1.2) from crates.io, pinned in `Cargo.lock` at [commit e141219d](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-indexer/commit/e141219d4f993378195f133425f41e3a501a8a9a) |

## Deployment information

- **Upgrade scope**: binary only. The indexer has no on-chain runtime; replace the five images.
- **Reset required**: No from `4.4.0-rc.5`, unless an earlier release has already indexed a ledger 8 to 9 hard fork; that deployment needs a reindex from genesis, wiping the indexer database and the ledger DB together. From `4.4.0-rc.3` or earlier, reindex from genesis, as `4.4.0-rc.4` moved contract state into the ledger arena.
- **Governance action required**: Not applicable
- **Downtime / coordination**: Where a reindex is required, the API serves incomplete data until it reaches the chain tip; plan the upgrade window for a full reindex. Postgres `010` and sqlite `012` run at startup in whichever component starts first, since every shipped config sets `run_migrations: true`. Upgrade chain-indexer before indexer-api (#1676).

## Artifacts

Multi-arch (`linux/amd64`, `linux/arm64`) images, also published to `ghcr.io/midnightntwrk` at the same digests:

- `midnightntwrk/chain-indexer:4.4.0-rc.6` — `sha256:04a078469be42b63b91007f05993a124f4d3521e2bbaae2a997e8f455be3f7cb`
- `midnightntwrk/indexer-api:4.4.0-rc.6` — `sha256:0293dead37a861c24d7ea6149414e2592e1ee43d3fe0fe7faccd41222ade1df9`
- `midnightntwrk/wallet-indexer:4.4.0-rc.6` — `sha256:74c2534db6cd83d775f121c3aa1eab58927a9facc8d15da0ad46090d17c8bf6c`
- `midnightntwrk/indexer-standalone:4.4.0-rc.6` — `sha256:e699cdc5002f4f089af91ba8c378ddc35879933f247e0502f7167fe12ede0bbe`
- `midnightntwrk/spo-indexer:4.4.0-rc.6` — `sha256:5d4c2b64b07f457f03031f6295b4c5f5240e756081b6feb97cdb73893717333f`

Each image carries a provenance attestation recording the `release` build profile. To check one:

```sh
docker buildx imagetools inspect midnightntwrk/indexer-api:4.4.0-rc.6 \
  --format '{{json .Provenance}}' | grep 'build-arg:PROFILE'
```

Each binary embeds its dependency list via `cargo auditable`, and each image carries an SPDX SBOM. To list the Rust crates it records:

```sh
docker buildx imagetools inspect midnightntwrk/indexer-api:4.4.0-rc.6 \
  --format '{{json .SBOM}}' | grep -o 'pkg:cargo/[^"]*' | sort -u
```

## What changed

- Security: a single transaction could halt indexing for a whole deployment, GHSA-67mp-mh58-qx5h (#1520, back-ported in #1524).
- Contracts untouched since a ledger 8 to 9 hard fork are served in the post-fork encoding, with a new `stateAt` field; breaking for `contractActions` subscribers, see Breaking changes (#1654, back-ported in #1676).
- Halt on a block's first regular transaction after a runtime upgrade to node 1.0.300 fixed (#1537, back-ported in #1554).
- Halt on a first regular transaction valid only at block time fixed (#1610, back-ported in #1613).
- Transactions the node refused at dispatch are recorded as failed, and failed transactions report zero fees (#1653).
- Viewing keys and session IDs no longer reach traces or logs in plaintext (#1667, back-ported in #1671).
- The `shieldedTransactions` subscription no longer repeats one transaction forever (#1681).
- DUST and shielded nullifier lookups no longer omit spends for prefixes ending in `ff` (#1729).
- `dustGenerationMerkleTreeUpdate` no longer serves a stale DUST generation leaf (#1672, back-ported in #1679).
- Idle session quota buckets pruned (#1668, back-ported in #1673).
- NATS subscriptions are registered before stored items replay (#1674).
- Standalone no longer panics on the first bridge event (#1496).
- SPO lookups accept a lowercase `0x` prefix (#1720).
- Node support: 2.1.0-rc.1 with ledger 9.1.0.0-rc.5 and 8.1.2 (#1505, back-ported in #1509), 1.0.300 (#1521), 2.0.0-rc.4 (#1517) and 2.1.0-rc.4 (#1535, #1618); back-ported in #1536 and #1621.
- Chain-indexer gc runs every 500 blocks while catching up (#1623, back-ported in #1734).
- Dependency advisories cleared: RUSTSEC-2026-0285 (#1493, back-ported in #1501); RUSTSEC-2026-0346, -0347, -0348 and -0349 (#1675); RUSTSEC-2026-0381, -0382 and -0383 (#1691); RUSTSEC-2026-0386 (#1700); RUSTSEC-2026-0391, -0398, -0403 and -0410 (#1704); back-ported in #1706.
- Images publish to Docker Hub again on tag builds (#1477, back-ported in #1500), and per-arch builds suffix the `latest` tag (#1690).
- Image builds use `cargo auditable` and attach an SBOM (#1711); back-ported with the workflow action bumps (#1669) in #1727.
- Routine updates: Rust toolchain 1.98.1 (#1709), the OpenTelemetry crates 0.33 and minor crates (#1714), back-ported in #1722; `async-nats` 0.50, `subxt` 0.51 and `blake2` 0.11 (#1663).
- QA test tooling only: `qa/tests` audit advisories cleared; these packages do not ship in the images (#1614, #1617, #1638, #1647, #1697).

## New features

### Feature node 2.1.0-rc.4 support

**Description**: The indexer tracks node 2.1.0-rc.4, with ledger 9.1.0.0-rc.5 on the v9 side and 8.1.2 on the v8 side. Ledger 9.1.0.0-rc.5 adds decode-side canonicality checks, and existing stored blobs stay byte-identical (#1505).

### Feature node 1.0.300 and 2.0.0-rc.4 support

**Description**: Node 1.0.300, the runtime mainnet runs, replaces 1.0.0 among the supported historic nodes, and 2.0.0-rc.4 replaces 2.0.0-rc.3 (#1521, #1517).

### Feature contract state anchor

**Description**: `Contract` and every `ContractAction` gain `stateAt`, a `BlockReference` with `height`, `hash` and `protocolVersion`, naming the block at which `state` last changed: the action's own block, or a later hard-fork block at which the state was translated.

## New features requiring configuration updates

None. The new `gc_catch_up_interval` key defaults to 500, so existing configs keep working.

## Improvements

**Improvement**: gc interval while catching up

**Description**: Chain-indexer runs gc every 500 blocks instead of every 25 while catching up, set by `gc_catch_up_interval`. A qanet sync to block 120,000 ran at 32.8 blocks per second instead of 6.9; at the tip `gc_interval` still applies (#1623).

## Deprecations

None.

## Breaking changes

### Breaking change post-fork contract state and `contractActions` replay

**What changed**: Before this release, after a ledger 8 to 9 hard fork the indexer would serve pre-fork state encodings for every contract without an action since the fork, which ledger-9 clients cannot decode (#1605). At the fork block the chain-indexer now records the translated state of every contract. `contract(address)` and `contractAction(address)` serve the translated state, `contract(address, offset)` serves the encoding of the offset block, and the `contractActions` subscription re-emits each untouched contract's latest action with its translated state at the fork block (#1654).

**What breaks**: three client behaviours and one operator behaviour change.

- A `contractActions` subscription with no contract action at or after its offset now replays nothing, where it replayed the address's whole history.
- `state` may be in a newer encoding than `transaction.protocolVersion`, for `contractAction(address)` without an offset and for re-emitted items.
- A re-emitted item keeps the original `transaction`, and its `stateAt` names the fork block.
- An indexer whose earlier release indexed a ledger 8 to 9 hard fork keeps serving pre-fork encodings until reindexed.

**Required actions**: for subscribers and operators,

- Subscribe from height 0 for a contract's full history.
- Decode `state` by `stateAt.protocolVersion`, and remove duplicates by `stateAt`.
- Reindex from genesis if an earlier release indexed a ledger 8 to 9 hard fork, wiping the indexer database and the ledger DB together.

**Code example**: a full-history subscription that reads the state anchor

```graphql
subscription {
  contractActions(address: "<address>", offset: { height: 0 }) {
    state
    stateAt { height hash protocolVersion }
    transaction { block { hash } }
  }
}
```

### Breaking change OTLP endpoint scheme

**What changed**: `opentelemetry-otlp` 0.33 rejects an OTLP endpoint without a scheme (#1714).

**What breaks**: With tracing enabled, an OTLP endpoint without a scheme now stops the indexer at startup.

**Required actions**: before starting this release,

- Give `APP__TELEMETRY__TRACING__OTLP_EXPORTER_ENDPOINT` an `http://` scheme; the shipped configs use `http://localhost:4317`.

**Code example**: `APP__TELEMETRY__TRACING__OTLP_EXPORTER_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:4317`

## Known issues

### Issue crypto-bigint advisory RUSTSEC-2026-0387 ignored

**Description**: `cargo deny` ignores RUSTSEC-2026-0387 in `crypto-bigint` 0.5.5, which arrives through `k256`/`p256` 0.13 in the midnight-ledger and midnight-zk crates (#1700, back-ported in #1706).

**Workaround (if any)**: None in the indexer; the fix needs those crates to move to `k256`/`p256` 0.14.

### Issue scanners report crates not in the binary

**Description**: `cargo auditable` on stable Cargo also lists optional crates the build never enables, so image scanners may report advisories for `quinn-proto`, `rkyv`, `rsa` and `ruzstd`, which are not in the binaries (#1711).

**Workaround (if any)**: None.

## Links and references

- **QA test coverage / test evidence**: —
- **PRs**: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-indexer/compare/v4.4.0-rc.5...v4.4.0-rc.6
- **Engineering docs**: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-indexer/blob/v4.4.0-rc.6/README.md
- **Migration guides**: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-indexer/blob/v4.4.0-rc.6/docs/re-indexing.md
- **SDK docs**: Not applicable
- **Security advisories**: [GHSA-67mp-mh58-qx5h](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-indexer/security/advisories/GHSA-67mp-mh58-qx5h)
- **Known issues board**: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-indexer/issues?q=is%3Aopen+label%3Apriority%3Acritical%2Cpriority%3Ahigh
- **Public schema**: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-indexer/blob/v4.4.0-rc.6/indexer-api/graphql/schema-v4.graphql
- **API documentation**: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-indexer/blob/v4.4.0-rc.6/docs/api/v4/api-documentation.md

## Fixed defect list

The following defects were fixed between `4.4.0-rc.5` and `4.4.0-rc.6`.

| Defect number | Description |
| --- | --- |
| PR #1524 | One permissionless transaction could make a block fail to build on every attempt and stop ingestion, GHSA-67mp-mh58-qx5h. Contract call entry points are decoded lossily, and contract actions from rolled-back segments are no longer stored or served; rows written earlier keep them, and `transactionResult` tells what applied. |
| PR #1554 | After a runtime upgrade to node 1.0.300, the indexer could reject a block's first regular transaction that the node accepted and halt. The parent-time offset now applies only to blocks built by runtimes that still skew. |
| PR #1613 | A first regular transaction valid only at block time was rejected, halting indexing; preprod block 164460 carries one. The indexer now verifies at block time and retries at the offset `tblock`. |
| PR #1653 | Transactions the node refused at dispatch were stored as successful, with fees paid and UTXOs kept, so wallets showed NIGHT and DUST that do not exist on chain. |
| PR #1671 | Viewing keys and session IDs could reach trace spans and logs in plaintext. |
| PR #1673 | The `shieldedTransactions` quota map grew for the lifetime of the process, one bucket per submitted 32-byte value. |
| PR #1679 | `dustGenerationMerkleTreeUpdate` served a DUST generation leaf from an older ledger state after a NIGHT spend. |
| PR #1681 | The `shieldedTransactions` subscription could repeat a transaction that adds no zswap commitment forever and never reach live updates. |
| PR #1729 | DUST and shielded nullifier lookups omitted spends for prefixes ending in `ff`, so a wallet could try to reuse a spent coin. |
| PR #1720 | SPO lookups returned `null` for an id with a lowercase `0x` prefix. |
| PR #1500 | Tag builds stopped publishing images to Docker Hub after `4.4.0-rc.2`. |
| PR #1690 | Final release tags failed to merge the multi-arch `latest` manifest. |
| PR #1706 | Dependency advisories: rustls-webpki and webpki roots for the emSign advisories, tokio and ctutils, and the zstd crates. |

name: Midnight Indexer 4.3.800-rc.2
body:
# Midnight Indexer 4.3.800-rc.2 Release Notes

> [!CAUTION]
> Upgrading from any earlier `4.3` release, including `4.3.7` and `4.3.800-rc.1`: **reindex from genesis required**. Those releases stored empty unshielded balances for every contract action, and this release corrects balances only for the actions it indexes itself. See Breaking changes.
>
> Coming from `4.3.4` or `4.3.5`, the reindex is also forced: those builds carried `4.4.0` content and its migrations, and this release refuses to start against a database with migrations it does not know.
>
> Wipe the indexer database and the ledger DB together, make the two config changes under Breaking changes, then index from genesis.
>
> Coming from any `4.4` release: **not an upgrade path**. That line indexes the ledger-v9 hard fork, which this release does not support. Track the `4.4` line instead.

## Metadata

- **Release type**: patch
  Pre-release of 4.3.800, which follows the published 4.3.7 final on the same line.
- **Date**: 2026-10-07
- **Sister-line note**: This release is on the ledger-v8 `4.3.x` line, which serves mainnet. Operators on the ledger-v9 `4.4.0` line should stay on that line.
- **Environment**: All environments running node 1.0.x
- **Released artifact(s)**: five container images; see **Artifacts** below.
- **Git tag**: [`v4.3.800-rc.2`](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-indexer/tree/v4.3.800-rc.2), signed, on [commit 5e64bcab](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-indexer/commit/5e64bcab66a451396b97c096ab71ddd84ae3784b)
- **Tree hash**: `43517a26c595c738abb2444aee6dfd94086f9023`
- **Component class**: core/infra
- **Upgrade scope**: binary only (see **Deployment information** below)
- **Reset required**: Yes
- **Governance action required**: Not applicable

## High-level summary

This release candidate fixes a transaction that could halt ingestion (GHSA-67mp-mh58-qx5h), two halts on a block's first regular transaction and a ledger-DB crash loop, clears seven dependency advisories, and moves to node 1.0.400 with ledger 8.1.3. Upgrading from any earlier 4.3 release requires a reindex from genesis, because those releases stored empty contract unshielded balances, and two config changes.

## Audience

- Operators running the indexer on the ledger-v8 line, on mainnet or preprod.
- Developers and wallet integrators using the indexer GraphQL API.
- Shielded Technologies engineering and SRE teams.

## Dependencies

- Supports node versions up to `1.0.400`; earlier node versions are expected to work. Node 1.0.400 runs runtime 1.0.300, whose metadata is byte-identical to node 1.0.300's.
- GraphQL schema unchanged from `4.3.800-rc.1`. Migrations: 5 postgres, 6 sqlite and 1 sqlite ledger-DB.

**Downstream impact (cascading effects)**: GraphQL clients that do not send `Accept-Encoding` or select the deflate WebSocket subprotocol see unchanged responses. Contract actions from segments the ledger rolled back no longer reach the API; use `transactionResult` to tell what applied.

## Tested-with versions

QA-verified: the 4.3.800-rc.2 test evidence records the run against node 1.0.400 (see QA test coverage under Links and references). The ledger version is compiled into the tested images.

| Component | Tested-with version |
| --- | --- |
| Midnight node | [`1.0.400`](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/releases/tag/node-1.0.400), the node the e2e and CI suites run against |
| Midnight ledger | `ledger-8.1.3`, pinned in `Cargo.lock` at [commit b5d3e965](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-ledger/commit/b5d3e965a18e4cac17fac4f38446fc55c524439a) |

## Deployment information

- **Upgrade scope**: binary only. The indexer has no on-chain runtime; replace the five images.
- **Reset required**: Yes. Reindex from genesis, wiping the indexer database and the ledger DB together, to replace the empty contract unshielded balances earlier 4.3 releases stored. Ledger 8.1.0 to 8.1.3 itself changes no serialization output and no storage encoding. A replay of mainnet and preprod history from genesis against ledger 8.1.3 indexed every block to the tip.
- **Governance action required**: Not applicable
- **Downtime / coordination**: The API serves incomplete data until the reindex reaches the chain tip; plan the upgrade window for a full reindex. Three index-only migrations run automatically at startup: postgres `007`, sqlite `005` and `009`. Rolling back to `4.3.800-rc.1` or `4.3.7` requires deleting `_sqlx_migrations` version `7` (postgres) or versions `5` and `9` (sqlite) first; the indexes can stay. A rolled-back build stores empty unshielded balances again for the contract actions it indexes.

## Artifacts

Multi-arch (`linux/amd64`, `linux/arm64`) images, also published to `ghcr.io/midnightntwrk` at the same digests:

- `midnightntwrk/chain-indexer:4.3.800-rc.2` — `sha256:c128b9967e9335e6f19dfb8db358523bf4c1c2c7fd782d08bf6b7a021852b6b3`
- `midnightntwrk/indexer-api:4.3.800-rc.2` — `sha256:c26a8ff8410620c011e5b4a50966619935e7ae31261d35155397061f44f60083`
- `midnightntwrk/wallet-indexer:4.3.800-rc.2` — `sha256:887a2aad2eb40319781b312e21296d0f98d9a3c47dae3bc873d641bd896c4882`
- `midnightntwrk/indexer-standalone:4.3.800-rc.2` — `sha256:76933b129b667f338af10f54885d1a541c2e37cb13c5cec697e913e0a9c380e9`
- `midnightntwrk/spo-indexer:4.3.800-rc.2` — `sha256:72b0da6440a09873f4252a1342602b994a9e697c4fd7f43d0d9a6429c28b182c`

Each image carries a provenance attestation recording the `release` build profile. To check one:

```sh
docker buildx imagetools inspect midnightntwrk/indexer-api:4.3.800-rc.2 \
  --format '{{json .Provenance}}' | grep 'build-arg:PROFILE'
```

## What changed

- Security: a single permissionless transaction could stop ingestion for a whole deployment, GHSA-67mp-mh58-qx5h (PR #1520, back-ported in PR #1526).
- Halts on a block's first regular transaction fixed for runtime 1.0.300 and for transactions valid only at block time (PR #1537, back-ported in PR #1548; PR #1610, back-ported in PR #1612).
- Ledger-DB root-count crash loop, empty contract `unshieldedBalances` and API worker starvation fixed (PR #1378, back-ported in PR #1528; PR #1246, back-ported in PR #1531; PR #1440, back-ported in PR #1534).
- Standalone mode no longer reports sqlite contention as "database is locked" (PR #1094, back-ported in PR #1530).
- Contract balances now come from the indexer's own ledger state; correcting balances stored by earlier releases needs a reindex, see Breaking changes (PR #1616).
- Node 1.0.300 and 1.0.400 support with ledger 8.1.3 (PR #1521, back-ported in PR #1544; PR #1651).
- HTTP and WebSocket compression, secrets from files, and subscription and unshielded-query performance work back-ported from `main` (PR #1252, back-ported in PR #1586; PR #1074, back-ported in PR #1587; PR #1583).
- Two config changes are needed before upgrading; see Breaking changes (PR #1385, back-ported in PR #1529; PR #1234).
- Dependency advisories cleared: RUSTSEC-2026-0204, RUSTSEC-2026-0258, RUSTSEC-2026-0285, RUSTSEC-2026-0190 and the rtrb, spin and chacha20 advisories (PR #1315; PR #1449; PR #1493; PR #1475; PR #1527).
- Images publish to `ghcr.io/midnightntwrk` alongside Docker Hub, each architecture built in its own job (PR #1591).
- QA test tooling only: `qa/tests` audit advisories GHSA-2883-xcg3-v3hh and GHSA-96hv-2xvq-fx4p cleared; these packages do not ship in the images (PR #1495, back-ported in PR #1538).

## New features

### Feature node 1.0.400 support

**Description**: The indexer tracks node 1.0.400 and ledger 8.1.3. Ledger 8.1.3 rejects contract call transcripts embedding non-canonical field values when decoding a transaction (PR #1651). Node 1.0.300 support from the same line is kept, since both nodes run runtime 1.0.300 (PR #1544).

### Feature compressed HTTP responses and WebSockets

**Description**: indexer-api compresses HTTP responses with gzip, brotli or zstd when the client sends `Accept-Encoding`. WebSocket clients can select the `graphql-transport-ws+deflate` subprotocol, which sends payloads of 256 bytes or more as zlib-compressed binary frames (PR #1586).

### Feature merkle tree rehash before collapsed updates

**Description**: Collapsed updates were built from the cached tree without rehashing, so an update could carry a stale hash for the most recently added leaf; the tree is now rehashed first (PR #1266, back-ported in PR #1584).

## New features requiring configuration updates

### Feature secrets from files

**Required updates**: none to keep the current setup.

- Optional: set `APP__X_FILE=/path` to load the value of `APP__X` from the file at `/path` (PR #1587).

**Impact**: Lets deployments mount secrets as files instead of passing them as environment variables.

### Feature bounded ledger-DB query concurrency

**Required updates**: none; the defaults apply.

- Optional: `ledger_query_concurrency` (default: half of `infra.storage.max_connections`) and `max_blocking_threads` (default 64).

**Impact**: Caps concurrent ledger-backed GraphQL queries so a burst cannot exhaust the blocking pool. Startup fails if `ledger_query_concurrency` is not below `max_blocking_threads`.

### Feature bounded SPO HTTP pool

**Required updates**: none; the block is optional.

- Optional: `infra.spo_node.http_pool` block.

**Impact**: Bounds idle Blockfrost sockets in standalone mode, which also opens sqlite in WAL mode with a 30s `busy_timeout` (PR #1094).

## Improvements

**Improvement**: subscription polling and progress caching

**Description**: Progress polling gains jitter and idle backoff, the shipped `keep_wallet_alive_interval` rises from `1m` to `10m`, and concurrent subscribers for the same wallet or address share one progress query (PR #1233, back-ported in PR #1583).

**Improvement**: unshielded transaction queries

**Description**: Queries by unshielded address no longer use an OR-in-JOIN that could hold pool connections until the 30s statement timeout under concurrent wallet sync. Owner-leading composite indexes back the rewritten queries: postgres migration `007` and sqlite `009` (PR #1133).

**Improvement**: sqlite block height index

**Description**: A UNIQUE index on `blocks.height` for sqlite, migration `005` (PR #1187).

**Improvement**: NATS reconnect logging

**Description**: NATS reconnects log at info level (PR #1297, back-ported in PR #1588).

## Deprecations

None. The GraphQL schema is unchanged since 4.3.800-rc.1 and nothing is marked deprecated; the `cache_size` rename is covered in its own section below.

## Breaking changes

### Breaking change reindex for contract unshielded balances

**What changed**: 4.3 releases up to and including `4.3.7`, and `4.3.800-rc.1`, wrote no unshielded balances for any contract action, so every contract's `unshieldedBalances` came back empty from the GraphQL API (issue #1245). The bug arrived with ledger v8 support in February 2026: when the chain-indexer read a contract's balance map it dropped every entry, so no rows reached `contract_balances`. This release reads every balance entry, and takes balances from the indexer's own ledger state instead of decoding the contract state bytes the node returns.

**What breaks**: The chain-indexer computes balances only when it indexes a contract action, and the API reads only the stored rows. A database indexed by an earlier 4.3 release keeps empty balances for every contract action it indexed before the upgrade. Neither fix forces a reindex on its own.

**Required actions**: after upgrading,

- Wipe the indexer database and the ledger DB together, then reindex from genesis.

**Code example**: —

### Breaking change ledger DB cache size key

**What changed**: `ledger_db.cache_size` is renamed to `cache_max_nodes` and takes a plain integer node count instead of a byte-unit string. The default is now 100000.

**What breaks**: A deployment that mounts its own `config.yaml` with `cache_size`, or sets `APP__INFRA__LEDGER_DB__CACHE_SIZE`, applies to chain-indexer, wallet-indexer, indexer-api and indexer-standalone.

**Required actions**: before starting this release,

- Rename `cache_size` to `cache_max_nodes` in `config.yaml` and give it an integer, or rename the environment variable to `APP__INFRA__LEDGER_DB__CACHE_MAX_NODES`.

**Code example**: `config.yaml`

```yaml
infra:
  ledger_db:
    cache_max_nodes: 100000
```

### Breaking change required progress cache config

**What changed**: indexer-api and indexer-standalone require an `infra.api.subscription.progress_cache` block.

**What breaks**: A deployment that mounts its own `config.yaml` without the block fails to start.

**Required actions**: before starting this release,

- Add the block with `max_capacity` and `time_to_live`; the shipped config uses `10000` and `"5s"`.

**Code example**: `config.yaml`

```yaml
infra:
  api:
    subscription:
      progress_cache:
        max_capacity: 10000
        time_to_live: "5s"
```

## Known issues

- **Engineering docs**: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-indexer/blob/v4.3.800-rc.2/README.md

- **SDK docs**: —

- **API documentation**: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-indexer/blob/v4.3.800-rc.2/docs/api/v4/api-documentation.md

## Fixed defect list

The following defects were fixed in 4.3.800-rc.2.

| Defect number | Description |
| --- | --- |
| PR #1526 | One permissionless transaction could make a block fail to build on every attempt and stop ingestion, GHSA-67mp-mh58-qx5h. Contract call entry points are now decoded lossily with NUL replaced, and actions from segments that never applied no longer drive a contract state lookup. |
| PR #1548 | After a runtime upgrade to 1.0.300, the indexer could reject a block's first regular transaction that the node accepted and halt. The parent-time offset now applies only to runtimes before 1.0.300. |
| PR #1612 | Preprod block 164460 carries a first regular transaction valid only at block time, which the indexer rejected before halting. The indexer now verifies at block time and retries at the offset `tblock`. |
| PR #1528 | `get_root_count` returned 0 or 1 whatever the stored count, so a later unpersist could crash-loop chain-indexer with "roots counts can't be negative". |

| PR #1616 | Indexing depended on every contract state the node serves deserializing with the indexer's ledger version. Balances now come from the indexer's own ledger state; a mainnet reindex produced identical balances for all 42,599 contract actions. |
| PR #1534 | A burst of unauthenticated ledger-backed queries could grow the blocking pool without limit and wedge the runtime, liveness probe included. |
| PR #1530 | Sqlite contention in standalone mode surfaced as "database is locked". |

name: Midnight Indexer 4.4.0-rc.5
body:
# Midnight Indexer 4.4.0-rc.5 Release Notes

**Release date:** 2026-09-04

**Release type:** Release candidate (**pre-release** — images published, pending QA sign-off) — ledger-v9 / node-2.x line

**Git tag:** [v4.4.0-rc.5](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-indexer/releases/tag/v4.4.0-rc.5) (`7a0b8d1e`)

**Tree hash:** `0ef631008fe5a5aa42993ff55cb712028b350b26`

**Environment:** stagenet and any environment on the node 2.x / ledger 9 line

> Note: this is the 4.4.0 line (ledger v8→v9 crossing, node 2.x). It is NOT the ledger-v8 mainnet
> maintenance line, which ships on 4.3.7 / 4.3.800.

## Summary

`4.4.0-rc.5` is `4.4.0-rc.3` plus everything that landed on `main` since — the ledger 8→9 hard-fork
crossing (#1444), contract state moving into the ledger arena (#1386), `protocolVersion` on progress
updates (#1463), and the advisory bumps (#1475) — plus one `indexer-api` fix on top:
`registeredForDustGeneration` is now scoped to the chain's current DUST epoch.

**Two things about this release candidate are unusual and worth reading before deploying it.**

**It was cut from an unmerged branch.** The fix it carries was found by a wallet user testing
`4.4.0-rc.4`, and the tag was pushed on the head of PR #1476 ahead of review and merge, so that an
image existed for that user to verify against. The tagged tree is therefore **not an ancestor of
`main`**, and the code in it has not been through review. `v4.4.0-rc.2-stagenet-hotfix` was cut the
same way, though that one carried no release object. When #1476 merges, `main` will get a squash
commit with a different SHA; if review changes the fix, whatever ships as rc.6 or final will not
match these images.

**There is no `4.4.0-rc.4` release.** rc.4 was prepared on `main` — a version bump and a changelog
section (#1474) — but was never tagged, so no images and no release object exist for it. The jump
from rc.3 to rc.5 is that gap, not a lost release. Everything rc.4 would have carried is in rc.5.

QA has signed off on neither the fix nor this build.

## Bug Fixes

- **Scope `registeredForDustGeneration` to the current DUST epoch (#1476).**
  `unshielded_utxos.registered_for_dust_generation` is computed once, when the UTXO is created, and
  nothing updates it afterwards. That is sound for the normal life of a chain — the ledger's
  `night_indices` is append-only, and `apply_registration` only ever attaches generations to NIGHT
  outputs of the registering intent itself — but not across a dust-wiping fork.

  The 8→9 translation replaces dust state with `DustState::default()`, stranding every nonce in it
  at once, which is exactly why the affected holders must re-register before they can pay a fee.
  Nothing retired the stored `true`: the wipe happens inside the state translation rather than via a
  transaction that could emit an event. The API therefore answered `true` where the ledger said
  `false` — telling holders they need not re-register when in fact they must.

  The flag is now scoped at read time to the chain's current DUST epoch, reusing the `dust_epoch`
  mechanism migration `008_dust_generation_epoch` already gives `dust_generation_info`. Read-time
  scoping rather than a migration backfill, so a re-index cannot write the stale values back, and
  deployments that already crossed the boundary on an older build are corrected without one.

  Verified by `indexer-tests/tests/hardfork_e2e.rs`, which drives a live 8→9 crossing and pins the
  `true` → `false` flip across the boundary (steps 4b and 8b). That test is `#[ignore]`d and does not
  run in PR CI; it was run explicitly against this tree and passed.

Everything else in this release is the rc.4 content, already described in
[CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-indexer/blob/v4.4.0-rc.5/CHANGELOG.md).

## Compatibility

- **GraphQL schema:** changed from `v4.4.0-rc.3`, additively. Three new `protocolVersion` fields on
  progress/snapshot types (#1463) and a description-only change on `registeredForDustGeneration`
  stating the new epoch semantics. No definitions added or removed, no field removed or retyped.
  **Unchanged** from the never-tagged rc.4 apart from that description.
- **Migrations:** 10 Postgres / 11 SQLite / 1 ledger-db. Two new per database since rc.3 (Postgres
  8→10, SQLite 9→11), both from the rc.4 range. **No new migrations** in the rc.5 fix itself.
- **Node:** 2.1.0-beta.1 (0.22.0, 1.0.0 and 2.0.0-rc.3 also present in `NODE_VERSIONS`)
- **Ledger:** v8 (8.1.1) and v9 (`ledger-9.1.0.0-rc.4`) coexistence, for the 8→9 crossing

## Upgrade from v4.4.0-rc.3

**Not a drop-in image bump, and it requires a re-index from genesis.** This is the rc.4 content
arriving, not anything in the rc.5 fix: contract state moves out of the database into the ledger
arena (#1386), and the old blobs cannot be converted — the arena nodes they would point at were
garbage collected long ago. Both stores, the indexer database and the ledger DB, must be wiped
**together**, since each holds references into the other. See
[docs/re-indexing.md](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-indexer/blob/v4.4.0-rc.5/docs/re-indexing.md)
before deploying.

There is no upgrade path from `v4.4.0-rc.4`, because no rc.4 images were ever published.

## Docker Images

Multi-arch (`linux/amd64` + `linux/arm64`), built from commit `7a0b8d1e` at **release profile**.
Verified pullable, both architectures present in every index, and each binary reports
`<component> 4.4.0-rc.5` from `--version`:

| Image | Index digest |
|---|---|
| `ghcr.io/midnight-ntwrk/chain-indexer:4.4.0-rc.5` | `sha256:6988eb6fbf384465bfa874c8d7c60c31ae3277c86f81e10539f405aec2878dc7` |
| `ghcr.io/midnight-ntwrk/indexer-api:4.4.0-rc.5` | `sha256:5a9eda301985d60c8c603ab985a11941bede8bce7b04a80e1fd1f8b17ffbf17a` |
| `ghcr.io/midnight-ntwrk/wallet-indexer:4.4.0-rc.5` | `sha256:4f08cbd1bba10475c5a5c3e4a16d7213a9d21dd932a4d9a6b9c13cb37183810b` |
| `ghcr.io/midnight-ntwrk/indexer-standalone:4.4.0-rc.5` | `sha256:480808d7d43d53a5fbb07df865f5d9b5acdc49d57a33c41b054febb21b75a6bf` |
| `ghcr.io/midnight-ntwrk/spo-indexer:4.4.0-rc.5` | `sha256:6f19d7694464432d6949a472eb6ea852e226ae273f15033ebc23940d32495ca2` |

Each image carries a `mode=max` provenance attestation recording `build-arg:PROFILE=release`, and
the label `org.opencontainers.image.revision=7a0b8d1e7853212e36af205c70f0436baac62606`. To confirm
independently:

```bash
docker buildx imagetools inspect ghcr.io/midnight-ntwrk/indexer-api:4.4.0-rc.5 \
  --format '{{json .Provenance}}' | grep -o '"build-arg:PROFILE":"[a-z]*"'
```

The same digests are also pushed to `ghcr.io/midnightntwrk/<component>:4.4.0-rc.5` — see Known
Issues; that path is **not** readable today.

## Known Issues

**The `ghcr.io/midnightntwrk/...` mirror is not readable.** Confirmed on this release:
`ghcr.io/midnightntwrk/indexer-api:4.4.0-rc.5` returns **403 Forbidden**. These packages default to
private on creation and are not linked to the repository. Pin the legacy
`ghcr.io/midnight-ntwrk/...` paths above, which are confirmed publicly pullable, until someone sets
the current-org packages' visibility.

**Docker Hub does not receive release images.** As with `4.4.0-rc.3`, nothing is published to
`docker.io/midnightntwrk/...`; that publish target was dropped when image publishing moved to the
dual-GHCR scheme in #1420, while the `Login to DockerHub` step remains in the workflow. Pulling
`midnightntwrk/<component>:4.4.0-rc.5` from Docker Hub gives `manifest unknown`. Note that
`docs/releasing.md` still documents Docker Hub as a tag-build target; the docs are stale on this
point, not the build.

**Both `Docker Compose Validation` jobs failed on this build, as expected.** The shipped
`docker-compose.yaml` defaults to `${IMAGE_REGISTRY:-midnightntwrk}` (Docker Hub) and
`build-indexer-images.yaml` only overrides `IMAGE_REGISTRY` to GHCR for non-tag refs, so the job
tried to pull from Docker Hub and got
`manifest for midnightntwrk/spo-indexer:4.4.0-rc.5 not found: manifest unknown`. The jobs are
`continue-on-error` and the run's conclusion is success; all ten image builds and all five manifest
merges passed. Set `IMAGE_REGISTRY=ghcr.io/midnight-ntwrk` when using the shipped compose file with
this tag.

**No `pre-commit` configuration.** The repository has no `.pre-commit-config.yaml` and no required
`pre-commit` CI check, which the company engineering rules require. Unrelated to this release's
content; noted because it applies to every build cut from this tree.

## Full Changelog

`v4.4.0-rc.3...v4.4.0-rc.5`: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-indexer/compare/v4.4.0-rc.3...v4.4.0-rc.5

Twelve commits: eight from the rc.4 range on `main`, then the rc.5 fix (`22d0339e`), its e2e
coverage (`0617cfb0`), the version bump (`6556a887`), and a follow-up that avoids extra queries in
the new scoping path (`7a0b8d1e`).

name: Midnight Indexer 4.3.800-rc.1
body:
# Midnight Indexer 4.3.800-rc.1 Release Notes

**Release date:** 2026-08-25

**Release type:** Security patch **release candidate** (pre-release) — ledger-v8 mainnet maintenance line (cut on top of `v4.3.7`)

**Git tag:** [v4.3.800-rc.1](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-indexer/releases/tag/v4.3.800-rc.1) (`c8d9b501`)

**Tree hash:** `49f0864b4bf33415f97f6bbef5779c4b7860816a`

**Environment:** Mainnet and any environment on the node 1.0.0 / ledger 8.1 line

> Note: this is a v8 maintenance patch — NOT the ledger-v9 / node-2.0 line, which ships on 4.4.0.

## Summary

A single-fix security release candidate for the mainnet line. It is `v4.3.7` plus one `indexer-api`
commit — no feature delta, no GraphQL schema change, no new migrations — so it deploys over the
current mainnet build without migration work.

The fix closes an unauthenticated denial-of-service vector in the SPO series resolvers
(GHSA-6746-qxvv-3hwg).

## Security Fixes

- **Reject unbounded epoch range queries (GHSA-6746-qxvv-3hwg).** The SPO series resolvers
  `registeredTotalsSeries`, `registeredSpoSeries`, and `registeredPresence` expanded the
  `[fromEpoch, toEpoch]` window into one row per epoch via `generate_series` and then materialised
  every row with `fetch_all`. With no cap on the span, a single ~100-byte unauthenticated request
  (e.g. `toEpoch: 9223372036854775807`) could pin a database connection for minutes-to-hours and
  drive `indexer-api` toward OOM.

  Spans wider than `MAX_EPOCH_SPAN` (10,000 epochs) are now rejected as **client** errors before the
  range reaches storage. Bounds are accepted in either order and the span is computed with
  `saturating_sub`, so extreme inputs such as `i64::MIN` / `i64::MAX` saturate into the rejected
  range rather than overflowing. Unit tests cover both the accepted and rejected boundaries.

  Commit `fcf93b4e`, in `indexer-api/src/infra/api/v4/query.rs`.

### Impact and exposure

Any deployment exposing the SPO series resolvers to untrusted callers is affected. There is no
workaround in configuration; the bound is enforced in code. Legitimate callers are unaffected — no
real query needs a window wider than 10,000 epochs.

## Compatibility

- **GraphQL schema:** unchanged from `v4.3.7` (`git diff v4.3.7 origin/release/4.3.800 --
  indexer-api/graphql/` is empty). The rejection surfaces as a GraphQL client error, not a schema
  change.
- **Migrations:** unchanged from `v4.3.7` — no new migration files.
- **Node:** 1.0.0 (0.22.0 also supported)
- **Ledger:** 8.1.0

## Upgrade from v4.3.7

Drop-in: bump the image tag and rolling-restart. No new migrations, no schema change, no chain
reset. Callers that today issue very wide epoch ranges will begin receiving a client error instead
of a long-running query — worth checking dashboards and any internal SPO tooling before rollout.

## Docker Images

- `midnightntwrk/chain-indexer:4.3.800-rc.1`
- `midnightntwrk/indexer-api:4.3.800-rc.1`
- `midnightntwrk/wallet-indexer:4.3.800-rc.1`
- `midnightntwrk/indexer-standalone:4.3.800-rc.1`
- `midnightntwrk/spo-indexer:4.3.800-rc.1`

Also published to `ghcr.io/midnight-ntwrk/<component>:4.3.800-rc.1`.

## Full Changelog

`v4.3.7...v4.3.800-rc.1`: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-indexer/compare/v4.3.7...v4.3.800-rc.1

Two commits: the fix (`fcf93b4e`) and the version bump (`c8d9b501`).

body:
# Midnight Indexer 4.4.0-rc.3 Release Notes

**Release date:** 2026-08-24

**Release type:** Release candidate (**pre-release** — images published, pending QA sign-off) — ledger-v9 / node-2.x line

**Git tag:** [v4.4.0-rc.3](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-indexer/releases/tag/v4.4.0-rc.3)

**Tree hash:** `ebc2936215c8791e8bc9e5590b07991bd01878f2`

**Environment:** stagenet and any environment on the node 2.x / ledger 9 line

> Note: this is the 4.4.0 line (ledger v8→v9 crossing, node 2.x). It is NOT the ledger-v8 mainnet
> maintenance line, which ships on 4.3.7.

## Summary

`4.4.0-rc.3` is `4.4.0-rc.2` plus the changes that landed on `main` since — most importantly the
node-parity fix for `block_fullness` accumulation (#1443) and secrets-from-files support (#1074).
GraphQL schema and migrations are **unchanged** from rc.2 (110 definitions; 8 Postgres / 9 SQLite /
1 ledger-db migrations), so upgrading from rc.2 is a drop-in image bump.

This release also **supersedes `v4.4.0-rc.2-stagenet-hotfix`**, an ops-only tag with no release
object that stagenet has been running. That hotfix was a release-profile rebuild of a
`workflow_dispatch` branch build which had been published at `dev` profile — where
`midnight-serialize`'s `RECURSION_LIMIT` is 50 instead of 250 — and which crash-looped stagenet's
chain-indexer with `exceeded recursion depth deserializing`. Everything in that hotfix is contained
here: the `block_fullness` change is byte-identical, and no migration differs. Environments on the
hotfix tag should move to `4.4.0-rc.3`.

## Features

- **Secrets from files (#1074).** `indexer-common` can source secrets from files via `APP__*_FILE`
  environment variables, rather than requiring them in the process environment.

## Bug Fixes

- **`block_fullness` node parity (#1443).** Use the node-identical stateless cost when accumulating
  `block_fullness`, so indexed values match what the node computes.
- **SQLite deadlocks in standalone mode (#1094).** Fix deadlocks and socket bloat in
  `indexer-standalone`.

## Dependencies

- **Node:** 2.1.0 (0.22.0, 1.0.0 and 2.0.0-rc.3 also present in `NODE_VERSIONS`)
- **Ledger:** v8 (8.x) and v9 (ledger-9 1.0) coexistence, for the 8→9 crossing

## Upgrade from v4.4.0-rc.2 or v4.4.0-rc.2-stagenet-hotfix

Drop-in: bump the image tag and rolling-restart. No new migrations, no GraphQL schema change, no
chain reset.

## Docker Images

Multi-arch (`linux/amd64` + `linux/arm64`), built from commit `56561b2f` at release profile.
Verified pullable:

- `ghcr.io/midnight-ntwrk/chain-indexer:4.4.0-rc.3`
- `ghcr.io/midnight-ntwrk/indexer-api:4.4.0-rc.3`
- `ghcr.io/midnight-ntwrk/wallet-indexer:4.4.0-rc.3`
- `ghcr.io/midnight-ntwrk/indexer-standalone:4.4.0-rc.3`
- `ghcr.io/midnight-ntwrk/spo-indexer:4.4.0-rc.3`

The same digests are also pushed to the current-org path `ghcr.io/midnightntwrk/<component>:4.4.0-rc.3`
— see Known Issues about its visibility.

## Known Issues

**Docker Hub no longer receives release images.** Every release up to and including `4.4.0-rc.2`
was also published to `docker.io/midnightntwrk/...`; `4.4.0-rc.3` is **not**. The Docker Hub
publish target was dropped when image publishing moved to the dual-GHCR scheme in #1420 — the
build workflow's image list is now GHCR-only, while the `Login to DockerHub` step remains.

Two consequences:

- Anyone pulling `midnightntwrk/<component>:4.4.0-rc.3` from Docker Hub will get
  `manifest unknown`. Use the `ghcr.io/...` paths above.
- The repository's own `docker-compose.yaml` defaults to `${IMAGE_REGISTRY:-midnightntwrk}`, i.e.
  Docker Hub, and `build-indexer-images.yaml` only overrides `IMAGE_REGISTRY` to GHCR for non-tag
  refs. So the `Docker Compose Validation` jobs fail on this release build (they are
  `continue-on-error`, and the image builds and manifest merges all succeeded). Set
  `IMAGE_REGISTRY=ghcr.io/midnightntwrk` when using the shipped compose file with a released tag.

**The `ghcr.io/midnightntwrk/...` mirror may not be readable yet.** `4.4.0-rc.3` is the first
release published under the current-org path (rc.2 and earlier predate the dual-publish in #1420),
so those container packages were created fresh by this build. Newly created GHCR packages default
to **private** and are not linked to the repository, so consumers can get `denied` until someone
sets their visibility and grants access. The legacy `ghcr.io/midnight-ntwrk/...` path listed above
is confirmed working and is the safe one to pin today.

None of the above affects the built images themselves, which are verified multi-arch and built at
release profile from `56561b2f`.

## Full Changelog

`v4.4.0-rc.2...v4.4.0-rc.3`: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-indexer/compare/v4.4.0-rc.2...v4.4.0-rc.3

# Midnight Indexer 4.3.7 Release Notes

**Release date:** 2026-08-17

**Release type:** Patch release (**pre-release** — images published, pending QA sign-off) — ledger-v8 mainnet maintenance line (off `v4.3.3-hotfix`)

**Git tag:** [v4.3.7](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-indexer/releases/tag/v4.3.7)

**Tree hash:** `19d29cafc68076e3ac938c10d00d6814ad9639fe`

**Environment:** Mainnet and any environment on the node 1.0.0 / ledger 8.1 line

> Note: this release pairs with node 1.0.0 and ledger 8.1.0 (the Midnight 1.1 indexer line). It is a v8 maintenance patch — NOT the ledger-v9 / node-2.0 line, which ships on 4.4.0.

## Summary

A minimal maintenance release for the mainnet line. It takes `v4.3.3-hotfix` (the emergency build mainnet blue/green have been running) and adds the dust-validity-window fix — so it resolves the dust `OutOfDustValidityWindow` / `IntentTtlExpired` case **without** regressing the runtime-upgrade enactment-block tolerance mainnet already relies on. Schema and migrations are unchanged from 4.3.3 (68 GraphQL definitions, 4 migrations) — no feature delta.

Version ordering does not imply supersession of the feature work: 4.3.4, 4.3.5, and the unreleased 4.3.6 branch inadvertently carried 4.4.0-preview content (ledger v9, c2m-bridge, storage gc-v1; +36 GraphQL definitions, +4 migrations). That content belongs to the 4.4.0 line; this release deliberately excludes it.

## Bug Fixes

- **Dust validity window (#1367, #1371).** Avoid `OutOfDustValidityWindow` / `IntentTtlExpired` on the first regular transaction of a block by reproducing the node's mempool `tblock` bump off the *parent* block timestamp, and seed that timestamp from the highest stored block on restart.
- **Runtime-upgrade enactment block.** Tolerate a runtime-upgrade enactment block in `get_contract_state` (consolidated from `v4.3.3-hotfix`, commit `f19c7ac`).

## Dependencies

- **Node:** 1.0.0 (supports 0.22.x as well)
- **Ledger:** 8.1.0

## Upgrade from v4.3.3-hotfix

Drop-in: bump the image tag and rolling-restart. No new migrations, no schema change, no chain reset — it is `v4.3.3-hotfix` plus one chain-indexer fix. Upgrading from plain `v4.3.3` additionally gains the enactment-block tolerance.

name: Midnight Indexer 4.3.3-hotfix — emergency enactment-block hotfix (off 4.3.3, superseded)
body:
**Out-of-band emergency hotfix — not part of the 4.3.4 / 4.3.5 release line.** Published for traceability only.

**Base:** `v4.3.3` (`a89e1d3`) plus a single commit (`f19c7ac`).

**What it fixes:** At the 2026-07-20 mainnet runtime upgrade (spec `22000 → 1000000`, enactment block `1,774,491`), the chain-indexer crashed on the enactment block. It selected the subxt runtime module from the block header's protocol-version digest — one version behind the block's live runtime — then called `get_contract_state`, which executes against the live state, so subxt rejected the mismatched module ("the static Runtime API address used is not compatible with the live chain"). This build makes `get_contract_state` try the digest-selected module first and, on failure, fall back across the other runtime modules; subxt admits only the one matching the block's live runtime.

**Deployment:** This is the image (`4.3.3-hotfix`) that mainnet blue/green ran to recover from the 2026-07-20 stall.

**Status: SUPERSEDED — do not build new deployments on this tag.** The durable form of this fix (select the runtime module from the block's live `spec_version` at every runtime-API / storage call site) lives on `main` (#1346) and ships in the next forward release. This tag does **not** contain the 4.3.4/4.3.5 dust-validity-window fixes, nor any of the ledger-v9 / node-2.0 / bridge / contract-events work — it is a minimal emergency patch off 4.3.3.

name: Midnight Indexer 4.3.3
body:
# Midnight Indexer 4.3.3 Release Notes

**Release date:** 2026-06-04

**Release type:** Patch release (4.3.2 → 4.3.3), Midnight 1.1 indexer line

**Git tag:** [v4.3.3](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-indexer/releases/tag/v4.3.3)

**Tree hash:** `1d8a93ff2cd9b5ef9573a42dc8bf9e31b18fe4c3`

**Environment:** All public networks (mainnet, preprod, preview, devnet, qanet)

> Note: this release pairs with node 1.0.0 and ledger 8.1.0 and is part of the Midnight 1.1 indexer line. Refer to MNF advisories for current deployment recommendations.

## Summary

Final 4.3.3, consolidating the rc.2/rc.3/rc.4 changes. It adds GraphQL WebSocket subscription quotas (#1104), the `'@beta'` directive for in-flight API fields (#1186), per-tree end indexes on `Block` (#1197), and a lazy `transaction` reference on the nullifier event types (#1208), tightens shielded nullifier input validation (#1126), and fixes fresh `dustGenerations` subscriptions to deliver dtime updates (#1166). It renames the dust nullifier byte fields with a `LeBytes` suffix (#1199), a breaking change confined to `'@beta'` (in-flight) fields. 4.3.3 is a patch release on top of 4.3.2: the only breaking change is on `'@beta'` surface, so there is no stable-API break.

## Dependencies

- **Node:** 1.0.0 (supports 0.22.x as well)
- **Ledger:** 8.1.0
- **Bundle tracking issue:** [Midnight Release 1.1](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-engineering/issues/1)

Both dependency bumps in this release are non-functional for the indexer: midnight-ledger 8.1.0 (#1141) is a version bump only from 8.1.0-rc.1, and node 1.0.0 (#1204) regenerated test data against the 1.0.0 release tag (previously 1.0.0-rc.3).

## Upgrade from 4.3.2

A patch upgrade: bump the image tag and rolling-restart. It applies one additive migration (Postgres `003_block_tree_end_indexes` / SQLite `004_block_tree_end_indexes`), which backfills the new `Block` end-index columns, forward-only, no chain reset. The ledger and node deps were finalised from release candidates (ledger 8.1.0-rc.1 to 8.1.0, node 1.0.0-rc.3 to 1.0.0), non-functional for the indexer.

## Docker Images

- `midnightntwrk/chain-indexer:4.3.3`
- `midnightntwrk/indexer-api:4.3.3`
- `midnightntwrk/wallet-indexer:4.3.3`
- `midnightntwrk/indexer-standalone:4.3.3`
- `midnightntwrk/spo-indexer:4.3.3`

## Audience

- [ ] Operators running an indexer on public networks (paired with node 1.0.0).
- [ ] Testnet and devnet administrators.
- [ ] DApp and wallet developers integrating against the indexer GraphQL API, in particular consumers of the dust subscriptions and the `dustNullifierTransactions` / `shieldedNullifierTransactions` subscriptions.
- [ ] QA and release managers.

## What Changed

| Change | Type | PR |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Add subscription quotas to the GraphQL WebSocket | New feature | [#1104](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-indexer/pull/1104) |
| Tighten shielded nullifier transactions input validation | New feature | [#1126](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-indexer/pull/1126) |
| Introduce `'@beta'` GraphQL directive for in-flight API fields | New feature | [#1186](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-indexer/pull/1186) |
| Add per-tree end indexes to `Block` | New feature (dust end indexes '@beta') | [#1197](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-indexer/pull/1197) |
| Rename DustNullifier byte fields with `LeBytes` suffix | Breaking ('@beta') | [#1199](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-indexer/pull/1199) |
| Add transaction reference to nullifier event types | New feature ('@beta') | [#1208](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-indexer/pull/1208) |
| Deliver `DustGenerationDtimeUpdate` items on fresh `dustGenerations` subscriptions | Fixed defect | [#1166](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-indexer/pull/1166) |

## New Features

### Subscription quotas on the GraphQL WebSocket ([#1104](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-indexer/pull/1104))

Adds per-connection and per-client subscription limits to the GraphQL WebSocket, so a single connection (or client) can no longer open an unbounded number of concurrent subscriptions. This is the indexer-side guardrail for the unbounded-subscription finding (pen-test HAL-02), bounding the database load a single client can drive.

### Tighter shielded nullifier transactions input validation ([#1126](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-indexer/pull/1126))

Hardens input validation on the shielded nullifier transactions surface so malformed or out-of-range arguments are rejected at the API boundary rather than propagating into query execution.

### `'@beta'` GraphQL directive for in-flight API fields ([#1186](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-indexer/pull/1186))

Introduces a `'@beta'` schema directive (applicable to `FIELD_DEFINITION` and `OBJECT`) to mark API surface that is still in flight and carries no stability guarantee. Several dust and nullifier fields shipped in this line are annotated `'@beta'`; consumers should treat those as subject to change without a major version bump.

### Per-tree end indexes on `Block` ([#1197](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-indexer/pull/1197))

Adds `zswapEndIndex` and the `'@beta'` `dustCommitmentEndIndex` / `dustGenerationEndIndex` fields to `Block`. Each is the chain's `first_free` (exclusive, "next free index") for that tree as of the block, written after all transactions — including system transactions — are applied, and is monotonic non-decreasing across the chain. Lets clients track per-tree growth directly from a block without a separate query.

### Transaction reference on nullifier event types ([#1208](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-indexer/pull/1208))

Adds a `transaction: Transaction!` field (`'@beta'`) to `DustNullifierTransaction` and `ShieldedNullifierTransaction`, resolved lazily via the existing transaction DataLoader so it is fetched only when selected, with no payload cost for consumers that don't request it. This lets wallet sync pull the full transaction inline from a nullifier match instead of gathering hashes and querying separately. `transactionId` and `transactionHash` are retained as the resumption cursor and sequencing key.

## Breaking Changes or Required Actions

### Dust nullifier byte fields renamed with a `LeBytes` suffix ([#1199](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-indexer/pull/1199))

Confined to `'@beta'` (in-flight) fields, so there is no impact on stable-API consumers. These fields are new in the 4.3.x API line and are not present in the 4.0.x production line, so production deployments are unaffected. Consumers of the beta dust nullifier API must update field and argument names:

- `DustNullifierTransaction.nullifier` → `nullifierLeBytes`
- `DustNullifierTransaction.commitment` → `commitmentLeBytes`
- `dustNullifierTransactions(...)` subscription argument `nullifierPrefixes` → `nullifierLeBytesPrefixes`

The shielded nullifier types are unchanged. The rename makes the little-endian byte encoding explicit in the field name.

## Known Issues

_To confirm before publishing: run `gh issue list --repo midnightntwrk/midnight-indexer --label "priority:critical,priority:high" --state open` and list any open critical/high issues not fixed in this release (Description / Issue link / Workaround). None known to be blocking at the time of writing._

## Fixed Defects

| Defect / PR | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [#1166](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-indexer/pull/1166) | Fresh `dustGenerations` subscriptions (startIndex 0, no prior cutoff) now deliver their `DustGenerationDtimeUpdate` items instead of short-circuiting the dtime drain, so a freshly connected wallet receives dtime updates for the historical range. |

# Midnight Indexer 4.3.3-rc.2 Release Notes

**Release date:** 2026-05-27

**Release type:** Pre-release (development line)

**Git tag:** [v4.3.3-rc.2](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-indexer/releases/tag/v4.3.3-rc.2)

**Tree hash:** `0671545f7897517f553d83f899e5f2014f2bb1dc`

**Environment:** All public networks (mainnet, preprod, preview, devnet, qanet)

> Note: This release pairs with node `1.0.0` and is the first release candidate for the `4.3.3` patch on top of the MN 1.1 indexer (`4.3.2`). Refer to MNF advisories for current deployment recommendations.

## Summary

Fast-follow patch on indexer `4.3.2`. Ships four targeted changes: a `dtime` fresh-subscription bug fix on the dust generation path, a per-connection subscription quota in `indexer-api` GraphQL WS closing Halborn pen-test finding HAL-03 (SSE-196), tighter input validation on shielded nullifier transaction queries, and a `@beta` GraphQL schema directive marking in-flight dust-generation work as unstable ahead of broader MN 2.0 changes.

## Dependencies

- **Node:** `1.0.0` (supports 0.22.x as well)
- **Ledger:** `8.1.0`
- **Bundle tracking issue:** [Midnight Release 1.1](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-engineering/issues/1)
- **Bundle review (shielded):** [shielded#21](https://github.com/shieldedtech/shielded/pull/21)

## Docker Images

- `midnightntwrk/chain-indexer:4.3.3-rc.2`
- `midnightntwrk/indexer-api:4.3.3-rc.2`
- `midnightntwrk/wallet-indexer:4.3.3-rc.2`
- `midnightntwrk/indexer-standalone:4.3.3-rc.2`
- `midnightntwrk/spo-indexer:4.3.3-rc.2`

## Audience

- [x] Operators who run an indexer on the `4.3.x` line (paired with `node 1.0.0`).
- [x] SDK consumers and dApp developers integrating against the indexer GraphQL schema, in particular consumers of `dust*` fields.
- [x] SREs and downstream service operators (wallet, faucet, mn.js, block-explorer) sizing per-connection subscription quota usage (per-connection cap enforced from `4.3.3-rc.2` onward on this line).
- [x] QA and release managers validating the MN 1.1 indexer patch line.

## What Changed

| Change | Type | PR |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Add per-connection subscription quotas to GraphQL WebSocket | New Feature | [#1104](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-indexer/pull/1104) |
| Tighten shielded nullifier transactions input validation | New Feature | [#1126](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-indexer/pull/1126) |
| Introduce `@beta` GraphQL directive for in-flight API fields | New Feature | [#1186](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-indexer/pull/1186) |
| Deliver `DustGenerationDtimeUpdate` items on fresh `dustGenerations` subscriptions | Bug Fix | [#1166](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-indexer/pull/1166) |

## New Features

### Per-connection subscription quotas on GraphQL WebSocket ([#1104](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-indexer/pull/1104))

Adds a per-connection cap on the number of concurrent GraphQL subscriptions a single WebSocket client can hold open, with a per-`session_id` rate cap on the `shielded_transactions` subscription. Default per-connection cap is 20 concurrent subscriptions; default `shielded_transactions` rate cap is 10 per minute (token bucket). Both are configurable via `indexer-api/config.yaml` and `indexer-standalone/config.yaml`.

Closes Halborn pen-test finding HAL-03 ([SSE-196](https://github.com/shieldedtech/shielded-security-engineering/issues/196)): unbounded GraphQL WebSocket subscriptions leading to resource exhaustion. QA coverage shipped in [#1184](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-indexer/pull/1184) (`subscription-quotas.test.ts`, two cases: per-connection cap rejection and slot reclamation on subscription close).

Operator note: downstream services holding many concurrent subscriptions (wallet, faucet, mn.js, block-explorer) should size their connection usage against the cap. Connections exceeding the cap receive a client-error response on subscription start.

### Tighten shielded nullifier transactions input validation ([#1126](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-indexer/pull/1126))

Hardens input validation on the `shieldedNullifierTransactions` query path. Invalid bech32m addresses, malformed hex inputs, and out-of-range cursor values now produce explicit client-side `ApiError` responses rather than reaching the storage layer.

Developer note: clients should treat `Client` variant errors on this query path as deterministic input rejections; previously some malformed inputs produced opaque server-side failures.

### `@beta` GraphQL schema directive for in-flight API fields ([#1186](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-indexer/pull/1186))

Introduces a `@beta` schema directive in `indexer-api` (declared via `async-graphql` 7.2's `TypeDirective`, mirroring the shape of the existing `@deprecated` directive). Backfills existing in-flight `dust*` fields and applies from day one to upcoming dust-generation schema changes targeted for MN 2.0 (tracked as midnight-indexer issues [#1181](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-indexer/issues/1181), [#1174](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-indexer/issues/1174), [#1168](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-indexer/issues/1168), [#1182](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-indexer/issues/1182)).

Consumers should treat any field marked `@beta` as unstable: behaviour, naming, and presence may change without notice between releases. Production integrations should not rely on `@beta` fields until they are promoted to stable.

Annotated surface in `4.3.3-rc.2`:

- `Subscription.dustGenerations`
- `DustGenerationsItem`, `DustGenerationDtimeUpdateItem`, `DustGenerationsProgress`
- `Query.dustGenerationMerkleTreeUpdate`, `Query.dustCommitmentMerkleTreeUpdate`
- `RegularTransaction.dustGenerationStartIndex` / `dustGenerationEndIndex` / `dustCommitmentStartIndex` / `dustCommitmentEndIndex`
- `DustNullifierTransaction.nullifier`, `DustNullifierTransaction.commitment`

No runtime enforcement; documentation-only directive on the contract maturity of the annotated surface.

## Improvements

None in this release.

## Deprecations

None in this release.

## Breaking Changes or Required Actions

None.

## Fixed Defects

| Defect / PR | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [#1166](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-indexer/pull/1166) | `dustGenerations` subscription did not emit `DustGenerationDtimeUpdateItem` records for clients subscribing from `startIndex=0` (fresh subscription, no prior owned entries). Fix replaces the `Option<u64>` cutoff guard with an explicit fallback to `0`, so the dtime backfill replays all updates owned by the subscriber's `dustAddress` regardless of prior subscription state. SQL filters by owner and per-stream event-id cursor, so the cutoff=0 path remains safe against duplicate emissions. |

## Links and References

https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-indexer/releases/tag/v4.3.2

Midnight Indexer 4.3.2

# Midnight Indexer 4.3.2 Release Notes

**Release date:** 2026-05-15
**Release type:** Bundle component — Midnight 1.1 (patch release on the development line)
**Git tag:** [v4.3.2](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-indexer/releases/tag/v4.3.2)
**Tree hash:** 9b2de1658b375e22323e6420eef372c0bf924aec
**Environment:** All public networks (mainnet, preprod, preview, devnet, qanet)

> Note: This release pairs with node 1.0.0 and ships as part of the Midnight 1.1 bundle. Operators on node 0.22.x should track the 4.0.x maintenance line, not this release.

⚠️ **Requires an indexer reset when upgrading from the 4.0.x line to 4.3.2**

The 4.3.x line pairs with node 1.0.0 / ledger 8.1 and carries accumulated schema and fee-computation changes since the 4.0.x maintenance line (node 0.22.x). Index state built on 4.0.x cannot be reused — reset the indexer and re-index from genesis on upgrade. Budget ~3–4 days at mainnet/preprod scale. Upgrades within the 4.3.x line (4.3.0 → 4.3.1 → 4.3.2) are drop-in and require no reset.

## Summary

Small patch release on the development line. Adds a `/live` HTTP liveness endpoint to indexer-api, allowing kubernetes to detect a stuck process the existing file-based liveness check could not. Fixes a `dustGenerations` subscription bug where the termination signal could miss in-flight wallet entries, replacing the per-wallet cursor check with chain progress and adding a re-drain to close the race window.

## Dependencies

Unchanged from 4.3.1:

- **Paired ledger:** 8.1
- **Paired node:** 1.0.0 (supports 0.22.x as well)
- **Bundle tracking issue:** [Midnight Release 1.1](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-engineering/issues/1)
- **Sibling release:** indexer 4.0.x maintenance line continues for operators on node 0.22.x (latest: 4.0.2)

## Docker Images

Five images publish at this tag (per `.github/workflows/build-indexer-images.yaml` at v4.3.2):

- `midnightntwrk/chain-indexer:4.3.2`
- `midnightntwrk/indexer-api:4.3.2`
- `midnightntwrk/wallet-indexer:4.3.2`
- `midnightntwrk/indexer-standalone:4.3.2`
- `midnightntwrk/spo-indexer:4.3.2`

## Audience

These release notes are intended for:

- Operators running the Midnight Indexer against node 1.0+
- Wallet integrators consuming the `dustGenerations` subscription, especially clients passing an `endIndex` that does not coincide with a wallet-owned generation index
- SREs configuring kubernetes liveness probes on indexer-api
- QA and release managers tracking the Midnight 1.1 bundle

(Operators on node 0.22.x should track the 4.0.x maintenance line, not this release.)

## What Changed

| Change | Type | PR |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `/live` HTTP endpoint for kubernetes liveness probe | New feature | [#1145](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-indexer/pull/1145) |
| `dustGenerations` subscription terminates on chain progress, not per-wallet cursor (with race-window re-drain) | Bug fix | [#1137](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-indexer/pull/1137) |

## New Features

### `/live` HTTP endpoint for kubernetes liveness probe (#1145)

Adds an HTTP `/live` endpoint to indexer-api alongside the existing `/ready` endpoint. SREs can configure this as the kubernetes liveness probe, replacing the previous file-existence check (`cat /var/run/indexer-api/running`) which could not detect a stuck HTTP server. With `/live`, kubelet auto-recovers indexer-api pods that have entered an unresponsive state by triggering a restart after the probe failure threshold.

Operator note: this is opt-in. To use it, update the deployment manifest's `livenessProbe` to an `httpGet` against `/live` on the api port. The file-existence probe continues to work for backward compatibility.

## Breaking Changes or Required Actions

None. Drop-in upgrade for operators already on the indexer 4.x.y development line.

## Known Issues

### Runtime-park hang under heavy concurrent merkle-tree-update load ([midnight-ledger#521](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-ledger/issues/521))

Under heavy concurrent merkle-tree-update load, `Sp::force_as_arc` (called via `BackendLoader::get` from `make_dust_commitments_collapsed_update`, `make_dust_generations_collapsed_update`, and related collapsed-update paths) can park the entire tokio runtime indefinitely. The pod produces zero log output (no errors, no panics, no background heartbeats) until kubelet's `/live` probe fails and the container is SIGTERM'd.

Per @tkerber on the ledger ticket:

> Note: We are moving to a mainnet release with this as a known defect. This is likely to have the following effects:
> - Indexer instances will be forcibly restarted when a deadlock/stall is detected
> - Such stalls are increasingly likely to occur under heavy load
> - An indexer restart *may* cause disconnection in connected wallet instances, which may lead to stalls in syncing until reconnected. This has not been fully tested.
>
> We are moving ahead with a release without fixing this because:
> - A prior fix attempt midnight-ledger#499 did not resolve this issue
> - Evidence pinpointing the cause is very weak, and we cannot definitively attribute it.
> - Restart/reconnect was deemed an acceptable mitigation while we work to find the underlying cause.

The `/live` HTTP endpoint shipped in this release is the detection half of that mitigation; the kubernetes restart path closes the loop. Root cause investigation ongoing at midnight-ledger#521.

---

Operators tracking other open issues in the indexer should consult the [`priority:critical` and `priority:high` labels in the indexer GitHub issues](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-indexer/issues?q=is%3Aissue+is%3Aopen+label%3Apriority%3Acritical%2Cpriority%3Ahigh).

## Fixed Defects

| Defect | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [#1137](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-indexer/pull/1137) | `dustGenerations` subscription hung in live-tail when the user-supplied `endIndex` did not coincide with a wallet-owned generation index. Termination signal moved from the per-wallet cursor (`cursor > end_index` strict) to chain progress (`chain_first_free > end_index`), aligning with the canonical pattern used by `dustNullifierTransactions` and `shieldedNullifierTransactions`. A re-drain step before yielding `Progress` closes the small race window between the storage drain ending and the chain-progress read. Wallets passing the chain's current `dustGenerationEndIndex` as `endIndex` now terminate cleanly. |

- [Full changelog](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-indexer/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)

> **Compatibility note**: This release pairs with **node 1.0.0** and ships as part of the **Midnight 1.1** bundle (May release). Refer to MNF advisories for current deployment recommendations. Operators currently on node 0.22.x should follow the 4.0.x maintenance line (latest: 4.0.2) instead.

* **Release date**: 2026-04-30
* **Release type**: Bundle component, Midnight 1.1
* **Git tag**: [v4.3.0](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-indexer/releases/tag/v4.3.0)
* **Tree hash**: cc0edf48419bdb942ea8e4bb0aecbb90e71ae9c5
* **Environment**: Development line, ships to public networks once the Midnight 1.1 bundle is promoted (currently exercised on QAET secondary against node 0.22.2; formal QA against node 1.0.0 happens before promotion)

## High-level summary

Development-line release on the node 1.0.0 / ledger 8.1 track, the indexer side of the Midnight 1.1 bundle. Three new features (SPO indexer in standalone SQLite mode, CLI `--version` without config, dust generation dtime updates in the subscription stream) and three bug fixes (in-memory pub/sub drain task lifecycle, dust subscription input validation, `/api/v3` and `/api/v4` redirect loop). No GraphQL schema breaking changes.

## Dependencies

This release is part of **Midnight Release 1.1**:

- **Bundle tracking issue**: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-engineering/issues/1
- **Paired ledger**: 8.1
- **Paired node**: 1.0.0 (supports 0.22.x as well)
- **Sibling release**: indexer 4.0.x maintenance line continues to ship for operators still on node 0.22.x (latest: 4.0.2)

## Docker Images

Five images publish at this tag (per `.github/workflows/build-indexer-images.yaml` at v4.3.0):

- `midnightntwrk/chain-indexer:4.3.0`
- `midnightntwrk/indexer-api:4.3.0`
- `midnightntwrk/wallet-indexer:4.3.0`
- `midnightntwrk/indexer-standalone:4.3.0`
- `midnightntwrk/spo-indexer:4.3.0`

## Audience

These release notes are intended for:

- Operators running the Midnight Indexer against node 1.0+
- Developers integrating against the Indexer API (queries and subscriptions)
- QA and release managers tracking bundle component versions for the May release

(Operators on node 0.22.x should track the 4.0.x maintenance line, not this release.)

## What changed

| Change | Type | PR |
| --- | --- | --- |
| SPO indexer in standalone SQLite mode | New feature | [#979](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-indexer/pull/979) |
| `--version` flag works without config | New feature | [#1083](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-indexer/pull/1083) |
| `DustGenerationDtimeUpdate` in `dustGenerations` subscription | New feature | [#1080](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-indexer/pull/1080) |
| In-memory pub/sub drain tasks survive lag | Bug fix | [#1063](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-indexer/pull/1063) |
| Dust subscription input validation tightened | Bug fix | [#1090](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-indexer/pull/1090) |
| Infinite redirect loop on unknown `/api/v3` and `/api/v4` paths | Bug fix | [#1093](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-indexer/pull/1093) |

## New features

### SPO indexer in standalone SQLite mode (#979)

`indexer-standalone` (the single-binary, SQLite-backed deployment) now bundles the SPO indexer alongside the existing chain-indexer / indexer-api / wallet-indexer paths. Previously SPO indexing required the cloud topology (separate `spo-indexer` binary against PostgreSQL plus NATS). Standalone operators can now produce SPO data without the cloud-mode dependency stack. External community contribution from hlolli.

### `--version` without config (#1083)

`indexer --version` (and the per-binary CLIs) now print version output without requiring a valid configuration file. Aligns with standard CLI conventions and removes an unnecessary failure mode in environments where config has not yet been mounted (debugging, CI inspection, container introspection).

### `DustGenerationDtimeUpdate` in `dustGenerations` subscription (#1080)

The `dustGenerations` GraphQL subscription now emits `DustGenerationDtimeUpdate` events alongside the existing dust-generation events. Wallet integrators get the dtime-advance signal directly through the subscription stream instead of needing to poll for it.

## New features requiring configuration updates

None.

## Improvements

None in this release. (Performance work continues on subsequent releases; perf entries in 4.1.0 introduced DataLoader batching across several lookups.)

## Deprecations

None.

## Breaking changes

None. This is a drop-in upgrade for operators already on the indexer 4.x.y development line. The Indexer API GraphQL schema is unchanged at v4.

## Known issues

No new known issues introduced by this release. The broader audit-finding work-in-progress (subscription guardrails per SSE #196, CI/CD hardening, etc.) is tracked under separate tickets and is not specific to 4.3.0.

The following defects were fixed in Indexer 4.3.0:

| Defect / PR | Description |

| [#1063](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-indexer/pull/1063) | Standalone-mode in-memory broadcast pub/sub drain tasks could exit after a lag event, leaving subscribers without further messages. Drain tasks now stay alive across lag. |
| [#1090](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-indexer/pull/1090) | Dust subscription accepted overly permissive input. Validation tightened against malformed input on the dust subscription path. |
| [#1093](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-indexer/pull/1093) | Unknown paths under `/api/v3` and `/api/v4` triggered an infinite redirect loop. Redirect handling no longer loops on unknown sub-paths under each API version prefix. |

# 🚧 Release Candidate

This pre-release is for validation/testing purposes only. It’s not suitable production deployments.

# Key Changes & Highlights

This pre-release comes with bug fixes and refactorings.

## 🐛 Bug Fixes

- (indexer-api) Queries return correct transactions and contract actions (#15)

See the full [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-indexer/blob/release/2.1.1/CHANGELOG.md).

## 🚜 Refactor

- (chain-indexer) Easier, more idiomatic way to apply transactions (#10)

# Compatibility

- This release requires Midnight Wallet 5.0.0 or higher (Lace Wallet 3.0.0 or higher).
- Midnight Ecosystem: Fully compatible with Midnight Node 0.12 and related infrastructure.
